name: SAFE_P0L1_V1
feature_policy: as-of-origin only; structure recomputed per origin
global_alpha: grid over [0,1] step 0.05, fitted on strictly earlier folds
candidate_search: none; P0L1 is the only condition run
addition: g_safe = alpha + lambda * (g_raw - alpha), lambda in [0,1]
lambda_fitting: weighted least squares in closed form under the direct loss's own mask and train-scale weighting; never a grid search
lambda_information_boundary: cross-fitted folds strictly earlier than the evaluation fold
cold_start_rule: lambda = 0 when no earlier cross-fitted fold exists
